calls.title: Jake / Matt 1:1
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies for improving sales efficiency by optimizing the retrieval of closed-lost deals, suggesting the use of advanced filters and automated exports to reduce manual efforts. Matthew proposed a new lead scoring system based on company size and job titles to prioritize referrals, decreasing the need for manual evaluation. The group also reviewed the current manual referral process and considered outsourcing for data cleanup. Establishing a consistent BDR owner field in the CRM was emphasized to ensure accurate deal attribution and compensation tracking. Lastly, the team outlined plans for testing referral automation workflows and maintaining close communication for effective implementation.
calls.keywords: Referral automation, CRM filters, Airtable CRM, LinkedIn scraping, Deal attribution, Outbound sales automation

calls.title: Jake / Matt 1:1
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies for improving outreach efficiency, deciding against further development of the N8N contact adding workflow due to personal preferences and limited practical use. Jake Stangl expressed a preference for manually selecting contacts on Sales Navigator to ensure important leads are not missed. They identified the need for better display of contact data during outreach, with Matthew Du Pont requesting input from Jake on critical LinkedIn profile elements. Jake successfully accessed the Dust AI platform, which aims to analyze historical deals for better targeting. The team reviewed previous campaign successes while prioritizing outreach to highly engaged former customers, and they agreed on creating a public Notion page for tracking outreach efforts and following up on alumni campaigns, with actionable next steps assigned to Jake.
calls.keywords: Apollo integration, Dust platform, LinkedIn profiling, campaign targeting, former user outreach, Sales Navigator
